answer.rationale: Deploy the already-confirmed shortened onboarding flow broadly for SMB self-serve. It improved completion, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not answer the competitor cut with promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment lifted signups and near-term revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, creating material downstream value risk. This does not establish that onboarding alone will offset competitor-driven price churn, but it is the strongest available sustainable lever under the exhausted verification budget.
